meta.name: chrome-automation
meta.description: 网页开发工程师与运营专员在需要自动化现有 Chrome 浏览器时必用！通过 CDP 协议无缝接管当前浏览器，自动配置环境并实时可视化执行任务。完美保留登录状态，一键完成复杂网页自动化流程，让繁琐操作自动化。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接管当前 Chrome 自动完成网页操作，保留登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要在网页上重复执行操作且需要保留登录状态。
copy.tagline_en: Automate tedious web flows in an existing Chrome with login preserved.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely repeat manual steps in a browser and need to stay logged in.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先自动检查并安装 agent-browser 及其依赖,再通过 CDP 接管你本机运行中的 Chrome,先取元素快照,再点击、填表、输入,并把每步浏览器画面截图给你看。
howto.when: 当你要求自动化现有 Chrome 浏览器(如自动搜索、填表、点击页面)时接管;它规定使用前必须先跑自动安装脚本,且不得改用内置浏览器工具。

say.text: 启动 Chrome 并用小红书搜索 labubu,把结果截图给我
say.note: 它会开页、填搜索框、回车、截图

say.text: 打开 example.com/form,把表单填好并提交
say.note: 会先取元素快照再按引用填字段

say.text: 接管我现在的 Chrome,截一张当前页面的图
say.note: 通过 9222 端口连当前浏览器

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude auto-checks and installs agent-browser and its dependencies, then takes over your running Chrome via CDP. It snapshots elements, clicks, fills forms, and screenshots each step back to you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to automate your existing Chrome browser, such as auto search, form filling, or page clicking. It requires running the auto-install script first and forbids falling back to built-in browser tools.

say_en.text: Start Chrome, search labubu on Xiaohongshu, and screenshot the results
say_en.note: Opens page, fills the search box, presses Enter

say_en.text: Open example.com/form, fill it in, and submit
say_en.note: Snapshots elements then fills by ref

say_en.text: Take over my current Chrome and screenshot the page I'm on
